problem: Durable closure could be fragmented, external-only, or separated from the canonical delivery lineage.
root_cause: The repository enforced material writeback artifacts, but did not yet state one explicit universal invariant that all four closure artifacts must be repository-native, same-lineage, reviewable and discoverable for every current and future agent/chat.
fix: Promote repository-native same-lineage borging to the canonical continuity policy, AGENTS.md and continuity skill, backed by regression coverage and the existing closure guard.
prevention: Keep skill projection, Brain learning, development ledger and human documentation in the same repository-backed lineage.
Chat-only, memory-only and external-only notes never satisfy canonical closure.
Shared preflight must discover the new learning and skill projection.
